scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance emerged from the Southern California hardcore punk scene around 1978, with Huntington Beach and Long Beach as its heart.
It was a modification of the 1976 British pogo.
Key figures like Mike Marine and venues like the Cuckoo's Nest are cited as foundational.
on_screen: Map: United States · North America
Image 1 with attribution

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: Moshing is a form of fan feedback and collective energy release.
While seen by participants as a positive expression of enjoyment, it is viewed by critics and some musicians (like Fugazi or Smashing Pumpkins) as violent, exclusionary, or dangerous.
Today it is a living tradition.
on_screen: Footage — MISSING (use images)

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: Participants push, slam, or run into each other within a 'pit.' Basic movements include the pogo (jumping up and down), the HB Strut (strutting in a circle while swinging arms), and the two-step (crossing legs over one another in a running-in-place motion).
Formations include circle pits, where the crowd rotates in a vortex, and the wall of death, where two sides of the audience collide.
Watch for Windmilling, Two-step, Floor punching.
on_screen: Hero video full screen, 30–45 s (xS5o0bZT4zY)
Captions name each signature move as it appears
Formation: Circular (circle pit) or linear (wall of death) within a confined 'pit'

scenes.title: Listen
narration: Originally performed to hardcore punk and thrash metal featuring fast tempos and distorted guitars.
The music often includes 'mosh parts'—slower, heavier sections designed for slamming.
Listen for the Electric guitar, Bass guitar, Drums, Synthesizers (in EDM variants).
The pulse is 4/4 at about 170 beats a minute.
A wall of distorted sound characterized by high-gain guitars and rapid-fire percussion, punctuated by sudden shifts to slower, crushing rhythmic sections known as breakdowns.

Listen later: Milano Mosh — Stormtroopers of Death; Caught in a Mosh — Anthrax; Slam — Onyx

scenes.title: The people
narration: Sid Vicious (credited with inventing the pogo); Mike Marine (credited with the Huntington Beach Strut); H.R. of Bad Brains (source of the term 'mosh'); Scott Ian of Anthrax (popularized the term in metal).

Huntington Beach Strut (circular arm swinging); Boston Thrash (punching below the neck); New York Hardcore (more violent, exaggerated arm/leg swinging); Brazil (where 'mosh' often refers to stage diving).
Descended from the British Pogo (1976).
on_screen: Names on screen as they are spoken
Variant names as a small list

scenes.title: Family tree
narration: moshing is parent of pogo: The vertical jumping style that preceded slam dancing.
moshing is influence of skanking: The two-step move in hardcore dancing descends directly from skanking.
moshing is variant of stage diving: Often performed in conjunction with moshing; in Brazil, 'mosh' is the term for stage diving.
